visualCharacteristics.purpose: Editable teal promo banner: display headline + script subtitle with core art; H1 instance is the page hero
visualCharacteristics.description: Teal (#2f9bb8) panel, white heavy uppercase headline with dark offset 3D shadow, white script subtitle, text left (~58%) and cropped core art right; stacked and centered on mobile. H1 instance: square corners, larger type, optional full-width decorative border strip below. H2 instance: rounded 8px, whole banner clickable via the text-cell link.

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: 2 cells (Core image | Heading + subtitle paragraph + optional link). Row 2 (optional): 1 cell (decorative full-width border image)
contentPattern.description: Holiday gift guide hero (Merry Everything) with lights/polka-dot border strip; Add Holiday Cheer gift-card banner linking to gift cards

usage.purpose: Editable promo banner (headline, script subtitle, core art); hero when the heading is an H1.

reuseGuidance: Use for text-on-color promo banners rebuilt from flat Scene7 art: author the copy as real text and only the cropped art as the image. Use H1 only for the page hero. A link in the text cell makes the whole banner clickable.
